scientific_integrity: The geometric bound is proved analytically with a finite exact rational interval certificate for the remaining facets; source literature supplies facet-completeness. Published priority remains subject to independent specialist scrutiny.
scientific_limitations: The exact invariant concerns one specified 10-dimensional coordinate realization with four nodes and indegree bound two, not arbitrary bounded imset polytopes, an intrinsic statistical metric, or an algorithmic performance guarantee. Full 94-facet description is prior work.
title: Exact Euclidean inradius and a five-dimensional incenter locus for the four-node bounded-imset polytope
